prompts.run: Use case: illustration-story. Production illustration for ArenaVoca's interactive manhwa football recap. Single coherent sports-webtoon panel, landscape 3:2 aspect ratio. NO text, captions, lettering, UI, numbers, logos, sponsors or badges. Adult athletic players, expressive crisp navy ink outlines, sophisticated cel shading, selective halftone texture, dynamic cinematic framing and restrained speed lines. Palette strictly warm cream #FFFAF2, electric blue #1646ED, navy #142352, lavender #ECE8FC and coral #FFC4B7. Lavender pitch with cream field lines. Blue-and-coral vertical striped shirts, navy shorts, blue socks on attacking team. Cream shirts and shorts on defenders. Stylised teaching illustration, not photorealistic or kawaii. Alba: short black hair, short beard, light olive skin. Coutinho: clean shaven, short dark hair, medium skin. Consistent clear ball and intact human anatomy. No collage, no interface, no border. Alba receives a ball while sprinting into space down the left wing. Side three-quarter cinematic view, runner dominates left/centre of frame, two cream-kit defenders are behind him to the right. Ball rolls just ahead of his left boot. Stadium softly suggested in blue/coral background. There is NO shot, goal, or celebration in this panel; it depicts only the run.
